payload.rationale: The obligation asks what 'first discharge' means under footnote (2) and how that trigger relates to the 'Once/5 years' WET monitoring frequency. The packet establishes that footnote (2) requires WET testing at first discharge and that the WET table lists both species at Once/5 years, but it does not define 'first discharge,' does not state whether the first-discharge test is separate from or resets the five-year cycle, and does not include Part II text referenced by footnote (3) that may govern additional WET conditions. Permit authorization language (effective date through dismantle) does not by itself establish a unique referent for 'first discharge.' Neither an affirmative resolution (ACCEPT) nor a grounded rejection (REJECT) can be supported from the packet. Per P5, unsupported uncertainty is preferred to unsupported semantic closure.
